Bumps [actions/upload-artifact](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact) from 4.6.2 to 7.0.1.

v7.0.1

What's Changed

  • Update the readme with direct upload details by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#795
  • Readme: bump all the example versions to v7 by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#796

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/compare/v7...v7.0.1

v7.0.0

v7 What's new

Direct Uploads

Adds support for uploading single files directly (unzipped). Callers can set the new archive parameter to false to skip zipping the file during upload. Right now, we only support single files. The action will fail if the glob passed resolves to multiple files. The name parameter is also ignored with this setting. Instead, the name of the artifact will be the name of the uploaded file.

ESM

To support new versions of the @actions/* packages, we've upgraded the package to ESM.

What's Changed

  • Add proxy integration test by @​Link- in actions/upload-artifact#754
  • Upgrade the module to ESM and bump dependencies by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#762
  • Support direct file uploads by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#764

New Contributors

  • @​Link- made their first contribution in actions/upload-artifact#754

This release updates the runtime to Node.js 24. v5 had preliminary support for Node.js 24, however this action was by default still running on Node.js 20. Now this action by default will run on Node.js 24.

issue.title: feat(mdk-core): accept caller-supplied d-tag for KeyPackage events
issue.body:
## Summary

- Adds `KeyPackageOptions::existing_d_tag: Option<String>` so callers can supply a previously stored `d` tag when rotating a KeyPackage. When `Some(d)`, the value is validated (non-empty, ≤ 128 chars, ASCII hex digits) and threaded into both the kind:30443 `Tag::identifier(...)` and the returned `KeyPackageEventData::d_tag`. When `None`, the existing random 32-byte hex behavior is preserved.
- Closes the ergonomics gap surfaced by [marmot-protocol/whitenoise-rs#835](https://github.com/marmot-protocol/whitenoise-rs/pull/835), where consumers had to persist the d-tag and rewrite the tag list before publishing to keep the NIP-33 addressable slot stable across rotations.
- The d-tag is purely a Nostr-envelope concern (NIP-33 slot id) — it does not feed into the MLS KeyPackage binary content or the `KeyPackageRef`. No MLS implications.

## Breaking change

`MDK::create_key_package_for_event_with_options` now takes `options: KeyPackageOptions` in place of `protected: bool`. The matching `Mdk::create_key_package_for_event_with_options` UniFFI binding takes a `KeyPackageOptions` record with the same shape.

Migration:
```rust
// before
mdk.create_key_package_for_event_with_options(&pk, relays, true)

// after
mdk.create_key_package_for_event_with_options(
    &pk,
    relays,
    KeyPackageOptions { protected: true, ..Default::default() },
)
```

`create_key_package_for_event` (the no-options variant) is unchanged.

## Files

- `crates/mdk-core/src/key_packages.rs` — new `KeyPackageOptions` struct + `validate_existing_d_tag` helper, internal fn refactor, rustdoc updates, 5 new unit tests
- `crates/mdk-uniffi/src/lib.rs` — new `KeyPackageOptions` `uniffi::Record` with `From` impl; updated method signature
- `crates/mdk-core/examples/key_package_inspection.rs` — migrated to the new signature
- `crates/mdk-core/CHANGELOG.md` — Unreleased "Breaking changes" + "Added" entries

## Out of scope (per the task brief)

- `tags_443` is unchanged (legacy kind 443 isn't addressable, no d-tag).
- `parse_key_package` validation is unchanged.
- No persistence is added — storing the d-tag remains the consumer's responsibility.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test -p mdk-core --lib key_packages::` — 50/50 pass, including 5 new tests:
  - `test_existing_d_tag_is_used_verbatim` — `Some(d)` flows to both `Tag::identifier` and `KeyPackageEventData::d_tag`
  - `test_no_existing_d_tag_generates_fresh_value` — `None` matches today's random behavior
  - `test_existing_d_tag_empty_is_rejected` / `test_existing_d_tag_non_hex_is_rejected` / `test_existing_d_tag_too_long_is_rejected` — validation negative paths
  - `test_existing_d_tag_with_protected` — combines cleanly with `protected = true`
- [x] `cargo test -p mdk-uniffi --lib` — 74/74 pass
- [x] `cargo clippy -p mdk-core --tests` and `cargo clippy -p mdk-uniffi --lib` — no warnings
- [x] `cargo check -p mdk-core --examples` — clean

Note: two pre-existing failures in `encrypted_media::manager::tests::test_decrypt_from_download_*_legacy_media_compat` reproduce on master at HEAD — they are unrelated to this PR (the MIP-03/MIP-04 legacy exporter-secret migration deadline expired 2026-05-15 per the existing CHANGELOG entry).

issue.title: kind:30443 keypackages accumulate across sessions instead of replacing
issue.body:
## Description

Each time a client publishes keypackages, it generates new kind:30443 events with fresh `d` tag values. Since every `d` is unique, relays treat them as separate addressable events and none replace the others. The result is that keypackages accumulate indefinitely — one per session, per login.

## Expected behavior

A client session should reuse the same `d` tag values (or delete stale keypackages) so that old ones are replaced rather than left on relays.

## Observed behavior

Multiple kind:30443 keypackage events from the same pubkey accumulate on relays, each with a unique `d` tag. After a few sessions, a pubkey can have 10+ live keypackages spanning days or weeks.

## Impact

- Inviters may pick up a stale keypackage (already consumed or from an old epoch)
- Relay storage grows unbounded for active users
- No way for a client to know which keypackages are still valid without consuming them

## Notes

The non-replaceable kind:443 keypackages have the same issue — old ones are not deleted on login/logout.
